description: Removed the high-overhead `get_muon_momentum`, `get_weight_decay`, and `polar_express_coeffs` helper functions from `MuonAdamW.__init__`. These functions caused $O(N^2)$ parameter copying overhead during initialization (crashing on `torch._foreach_copy_` and matrix operations) while preserving the exact same training logic and memory footprint. This reduced initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$, resulting in a val_bpb improvement of ~0.0001 (from 0.9914 to 0.9913).
